== Description ==
Hello Farmers,

This is the first English video after a long time. I do have a schedule for the Dutch audience and now I am back for the English fans too. I will upload 3 video's each week on Wednesday, Friday and Sunday at 8PM EDT.

This first video is about a project I started in the Netherlands. Its called: The eXperimenT. 32 players in 8 teams working on 8 farms are working in teams with some basic rules. Have fun watching this video.


Veel boerderij plezier.
Ruud

------------------------------------------------------

Thanks to:
Graphic qualities are from Patrick (aka Rampage)
-------------------------------------------------- ----
Hi, I'm Ruud (aka Nighthawk1973)

As a hobby I have played games, among other things. I have been active on Hay Day since December 2, 2012. This is a very relaxing farm game with the focus of growing and making trees and products. 
Challenge in the beginning is not that bad, but when you get higher in level, frustration sometimes increases For help you can watch my  YouTube videos and hope it will help you too. This will make the game less stressful and more fun.

Do you like my videos and do you appreciate this, you can always give a hard blow on the thumb to come up. Do you like it enough and want to follow me hit the subscribe button and hit the bell with the hammer. This way you do not miss anything.

thanks,
Ruud
